quests.title: Herbalist's Forage

dialogue.t: Ah, you must've seen my commission. You've come just in time, can you find me three Violetgrass?
Let me see... Yes, this Violetgrass will do nicely.
Here, these are for you. Thanks for your help.

quests.description: Liyue Harbor’s Herbalist Gui needs three Violetgrass.
